description: Three deferred unit-test files (tests/flow/test_git_refs.py, tests/flow/review/test_conflict_gate.py, and tests/test_calibration_diff_property.py) still spawn repeated per-test git init/commit subprocesses or heavy property iterations instead of reusing template repositories and lean hermetic fixtures, inflating every CI unit test run.
goal: Speed up and clean up the three deferred unit-test files apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_git_refs.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/review/test_conflict_gate.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_calibration_diff_property.py without modifying any production source code, tests/conftest.py, or holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Reuse existing template-repo / shared fixture helpers (or module-scoped read-only template clones and batched git plumbing) to cut subprocess spawns and summed wall time across those 3 files while preserving every tested behavior, edge case, line/branch coverage, and assertion strength (never deleting unique coverage or weakening assertions). Measure before and after timing for the 3 files with uv run pytest and verify the full unit suite and uv run task lint pass. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Cutting repeated git subprocess spawns across these three deferred test files lowers CI unit-suite runtime on every pull request with zero production-code risk.
acceptance_criteria: Test areas deferred earlier (`test_git_refs.py`, `test_conflict_gate.py`, `test_calibration_diff_property.py`) are cleaned up.
Line and branch coverage do not fall, and the mutation score of touched modules does not fall.
The module budget file is not changed.

All changes remain strictly test-only within apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_git_refs.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/review/test_conflict_gate.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_calibration_diff_property.py, uv run pytest and uv run task lint pass with measurable speedup, and code is self-explaining (no docstrings; only '# why:' comments).
